meta.title: Sidebar status filter
meta.description: Adds a chip row under the workspace toolbar: All / Running / Needs confirmation / Unread, each with a live count. Clicking a chip lists every matching session (workspace · title · age) and opens one on click; turning off returns the official list. Working areas and the 'show more' truncation inside them are expanded automatically, so the count always equals the number of rows shown. Also puts a small status dot at the end of each session row: green running, orange needs confirmation, blue unread. Read-only: derives state from ctx.sessions.list, uiSession.sessionStatus and the userQuestions projection, writes nothing, and hides the official list only while a filter is active.
